items.title: Tech pulls back on AI concerns, cybersecurity takes a step up
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Markets Reporter Ines Ferre and DA Davidson Head of Technology Research Gil Luria break down the tech stock (XLK) pullback following calls to slow AI development, while highlighting the renewed strength in the cybersecurity sector.

items.title: Cybersecurity stocks get a jolt on gloomy AI warnings from CEOs of Anthropic and OpenAI
items.summary: A boost for at least one sector of AI.

items.title: Palo Alto and CrowdStrike Gain While AI Names Fall
items.summary: Amodei, Altman and Musk all called for slowing capability development this weekend

items.title: The next AI boom could be hiding in cybersecurity
items.summary: Nvidia’s CEO sees cybersecurity as AI’s next leg. CrowdStrike and Anthropic’s last two months suggest he’s not wrong.

items.title: Cybersecurity Stocks Surge as AI Safety Warnings Spark Security Bid: CrowdStrike and Zscaler Jump 12%, Palo Alto Rallies 11%
items.summary: AI safety warnings from two frontier lab CEOs sent shockwaves through chipmakers over the weekend, but cybersecurity stocks are telling a completely different story about what those warnings mean for the threat environment ahead.

items.title: Cybersecurity Stocks Jump As Anthropic CEO’s AI Slowdown Call Sharpens Focus On Cyber Risks – CRWD, PANW, FTNT Buck Market Selloff
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for slowing frontier AI development, while OpenAI CEO Sam Altman backed the idea and said the firm would also adopt independent evaluators with employee-like access.

items.title: AI Trade Stumbles as CEOs Talk Model Slowdown
items.summary: Most of the AI trade is hitting the brakes this morning.

items.title: Why CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Are Leading the Software Stock Rally
items.summary: CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks are leading a software rally as concerns about AI safety give cybersecurity stocks an added boost.
